stories.headline: Meta just open-sourced its most powerful AI model
stories.blurb: Meta released Muse Glimmer as a free download that anyone can modify and run. The move puts cutting-edge AI capabilities in the hands of developers without the usual API fees or usage restrictions, though it's certain to reignite the debate over whether the most powerful models should be freely available.
stories.why_it_matters: Open-weight releases let engineers experiment without corporate gatekeepers or per-token costs.
stories.original_headline: Meta Unveils ‘Open Source’ Version of Its Most Powerful A.I. Model

stories.headline: Claude Code will now run itself without asking permission
stories.blurb: Anthropic is flipping auto mode on by default in Claude Code, meaning the AI coding agent will execute commands, run tests, and iterate on fixes without stopping for human approval each time. You'll still see what it's doing, but it won't wait for a green light.
stories.why_it_matters: Coding agents just got faster but also harder to stop mid-task.
stories.original_headline: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default

stories.headline: Ford's AI assistant can now check your fuel and tire pressure
stories.blurb: Ford is adding an AI assistant to its mobile app that answers questions about your car — like how much gas you need for a road trip or whether your truck can tow a boat. It can also check real-time stats like fuel levels and tire pressure directly from the app.
stories.why_it_matters: Car data is moving from the dashboard to conversational AI in your pocket.
stories.original_headline: Ford’s new AI assistant can check your fuel levels and tire pressure

stories.headline: OpenAI just bought a presentation startup and folded it into ChatGPT
stories.blurb: OpenAI acquired NextSlide, a presentation tool startup, and brought its team into ChatGPT development. The move signals OpenAI is pushing deeper into productivity software beyond chat, potentially building native slide-creation features into ChatGPT itself.
stories.why_it_matters: ChatGPT may soon generate and edit slides natively, not just suggest text for decks.
